title: Breath Awareness
description: Five minutes resting attention on the breath, and returning to it.

segments.say: Let us begin. Settle into a position you can hold comfortably.
Now let your breathing return to normal. Do not control it.
Feel the air as it enters your nose.
You do not need to breathe deeply. Just notice what is already happening.
When your mind wanders, and it will, that is not a mistake.
Simply notice where it went, and come back to the breath.
Back to the air at the tip of the nose.
Take one more deep breath in.
When you are ready, open your eyes.
